R2 C66 the review copy for a member who may not share draws no share boxes without a button; a member who may draws them (control)
R42 C67 a sign step that was not reached draws no minutes line; one that was reached and could not read its minutes still does (control)
R13 G29 a document row signs at the row's own `bundle_sha` and never at its capture or its classification; a row without one is named as not signable and no line is drawn for it

R44 the Bias step holds the member's own words and the pre-flight and the publish send them as biasAcknowledgement; none typed sends none

R53 with no reason the shell asks and nothing is sent (control); a project citing nothing draws no section

R57 the ceremony lists the four details stated or not stated and no Publish is disabled by them; published draws what casedetailspublic answers and nothing for a field not stated (control)

R59 the assistant helps with the citing note only while it is reachable: it sends the note for citeimported and draws wizard-scripts' real refusal in its words, the field left as typed (B420 3); not reachable draws no help (control)
R57 the details are named by key, Not stated by key and 'Take out' by key; the ceremony marks a stated detail 'Stated' (B428)
R57 a related work is drawn by its relation's word; a published 'no relationships' is drawn by its key
R44 a finding's role choice is labelled by 'Finding {n}: its role in the case' and its two choices by key (B428)
R51 each document held without a second confirmation has its tick 'Publish {document} as self-attested only' (B428)

outside.waitsOn: interface-shell: the item in its interface files
tests: R2 R18 each named reader is a row with what they may read and until when, drawn "until <date>" from the grant's own end in the group's zone (not the UTC day), offering "Stop sharing"
R18 a lapsed grant is drawn ended; a grant with no end date draws "until you stop sharing" (controls)
R18 "Share with a named reader" sends `until` as the end of the chosen day in the group's zone, an instant in the stamp form (summer, winter and a zone east of Greenwich)
R18 R27 with no time zone held, or a date that is no day, nothing is shared and the member is told why in the fold (controls)
R18 REVIEW_BAD_UNTIL is drawn by its words, the form keeps what was typed, and nothing is shared (a past date)
R2 "Share with a named reader" takes a name, a role and an end date, is marked outward, and sends nothing without them (control)
R2 R11 the grant's secret is shown once as the reader's link with "Civicsmith sends no email", and kept in no storage, address or later request
R2 the readers' comments, each answered by "Reply" (reviewcomment with the draft and the member's words)
R17 review-outside: the fragment's secret goes only in reviewcopy's body, the address loses it on load, no session is read
R17 review-outside: the link's end date, and "Send your comment" with the secret in the body; with no link nothing is read (control)
R23 review-outside draws "What the case says it does not cover" with the group's statement, the reader's note and "Acknowledge it"
R23 "Acknowledge it" sends statementack with the draft, the note as the reason and the secret, the secret in the body only, never in an address
R23 an empty note is refused and nothing is sent (control); STATEMENT_ACK_NO_REASON and the dead answer are drawn by their words and the note is kept
R23 a copy whose statement is absent draws no section and no acknowledgement (control); a statementack answered ok that carries a refusal is not sent (D29)
